newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police arrest suspected Italian mafia boss.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police arrest suspected Italian mafia boss.

text.p: Spanish police said on Thursday they had arrested a suspected top mafia gangster and seized drugs, money and arms as part of a joint operation with Italian authorities.

Giuseppe Belfiore, the 38-year-old alleged leader of the northern Italian branch of the 'ndrangheta mafia, was arrested along with two of his colleagues in the southern Spanish coastal town of Almunecar, police said.

In a nationwide operation which began in Barcelona in July, police also arrested 11 suspected mafia mobsters last week and seized over a tonne of hashish and 20 million pesetas ($125,000) in cash, vehicles and arms.
Belfiore is wanted by Italian authorities for drug trafficking, mafia association and involvement in a number of murders in Italy's Turin province, police said.
In Spain, Belfiore is suspected of leading money laundering and drug trafficking operations.

Italian police have carried out numerous strikes against the 'ndrangheta, the organized crime group which operates mainly in the southern Calabria region but has spread to northern Italy in the last few years. Police have arrested several top 'ndrangheta bosses in recent months. ($ = 159.5 Spanish Pesetas)
